name: B-spline FEM contact simulation in D

mentions.name: B-spline FEM contact simulation in D
mentions.description: This is a long-term contact simulation written in D that applies B-spline finite element techniques from Klaus Hollig's book, focusing on level set domains and high-order boundary parametrizations. It explores how efficient this largely meshless approach can be, especially with multigrid, with the goal of cross-pollinating ideas with the author's professional numerics and geometry work.
mentions.source_excerpt: I've got a long term project trying to see how far I can get writing a contact simulation using techniques from Klaus Hollig's book on B-spline finite element methods. I'm using D for this. I've been focusing on level set domains, which has led to me spending an inordinate amount of time on high order boundary parametrizations.
